description.value: Kirin is a long-established fine Chinese restaurant group that has operated in Metro Vancouver since 1987, with its Richmond location anchored at the Three West Centre on Westminster Highway. The Richmond outpost specializes in Cantonese cuisine — including dim sum, fresh seafood, and elaborate banquet menus — overseen by Head Chef Kin Ming Tam. A touring cyclist seeking a substantial sit-down meal or dim sum lunch would find this a notable stop in Richmond's dining landscape.
